# Yardlet 0.11.16
## Conversation
- Messages from Claude Code, Antigravity and other harnesses that don't mark working notes now stay visible in full, and tool-only stretches between messages fold into one-line summaries. - Turns with several messages offer **Copy full response**. - Hover or focus a message to see when it was sent.
## Windows, tabs and panes
- Two or more tabs in a window get their own browser-style tab bar. - The focused split pane stands out more clearly, and a pane can be maximized with ⌃⌘↩. - The Session Rail's on/off state now stays with each task, across split panes and windows. - Narrow side panels and the raised rail float as inset cards, with finer alignment, spacing and colors throughout.
## Simulators
- When another task already uses an iOS simulator or Android emulator, a task gets its own isolated copy of that device. - A task can open several Simulator tabs, each with its own device, and xctest batches no longer run in the terminal.
## Settings and tools
- **MCP Code Mode** moved to **Settings › General › Tasks**. - `browser_snapshot` accepts `query` and `maxResults` to return only matching parts of a page.
## Codex and Antigravity
- Codex speed tiers and lazy MCP startup work with Codex 0.172. - Antigravity offers only conversations still on disk, and its index no longer stops at a fixed size.
## Faster
- Markdown rendering in transcripts, power source checks, lid helper status at launch and file change previews no longer hold up the main thread.
## Fixes
- A saved-password fill on a page that changed underneath it now asks the agent to read the page again instead of reporting a browser refusal.

# Yardlet 0.11.15
## Languages
- Japanese and Simplified Chinese localizations are now included alongside English and Korean, with English fallback for any missing string.
## Workspace and sidebar
- A unified vertical sidebar navigation organizes Home, Mail, Calendar, Tasks, and Projects with refined surface depth, composer contrast, and an accent send button. - Turn a chat into a project of its own folder from its menu or by dropping it onto Projects, start nested tasks from a task's menu, collapse task families inline, and clear the hero project filter in one click. - The turn rail's marks are easier to click without a focus ring.
## Antigravity and other harnesses
- Queued messages on Antigravity and other turn-by-turn harnesses now offer **Stop and send**, cancelling the running turn and sending the chosen follow-up immediately once the turn stops. - Antigravity connector tools route through a compact MCP gateway and avoid duplicate MCP server registrations on resume, keeping built-in tools within the eager tool budget, and Yardlet MCP tool rows display clean names without per-session hash prefixes. - Antigravity subagents appear in the session rail and side panel, autonomous turns no longer duplicate or leak stale streams, and scheduled-task and session tools support Antigravity permission modes. - Interactive `show_widget` views render locally and in remote desktop windows for ACP harnesses. - Live thinking previews stream without Commentary flicker across harnesses, with reliability fixes across non-primary harness adapters.
## Another Mac's tasks
- Mail, Calendar, and command shortcuts are available in the remote Mac window, and connectors can be set up from remote Mac settings. - Remote browser tabs capture faster and preserve viewport width without clipping. - Remote archive navigation no longer resets unexpectedly, and chats are labeled Chats on another Mac's Environment card.
## Browser and tools
- Copy a saved password from the browser key menu. - Agent tools can read archived tasks in read-only mode. - Optional experimental **MCP Code Mode** under **Settings › Connectors** collapses flat connector schemas behind `search_yardlet_tools` and a sandboxed JavaScript `run_yardlet_script` tool (off by default). - Released `yardlet-mcp` servers exit cleanly when no longer needed.
## Faster and fixes
- Conversation search runs outside the sidebar render, finished subagent conversations save off the main thread, and conversations draw through the unified row list. - Fixed a main-queue deadlock when background preference writes notified `UserDefaults` observers while the main thread flushed state. - Sidebar task commands are guarded outside the Tasks section, and remote push targets bind to the room that registered them.
## Thanks
- Thanks to @Greensy24 for contributing remote Mac connector setup (#1007).

# Yardlet 0.11.14
## Security
- Keys and tokens in what the browser, session and terminal tools return are hidden in more cases.
## Another Mac's tasks
- File › Connect to Mac… lists the other Macs signed in to your Yardlet account with remote connections turned on, and connects to the one you choose without a number to confirm. You can sign in from there, and a connection link still works under Use a connection link. - When the other Mac runs an earlier Yardlet, or the account cannot approve the connection yet, you confirm a number on the other Mac or on a phone already connected to it, as before. - Settings › Yardlet Account says that Macs signed in to the same account can connect to this one.
## Conversation
- A Claude Code `/compact` that fails, whether you typed it or Yardlet ran it while the task was idle, shows as a failed compaction with Claude Code's reason, also after a relaunch. - The Settings window and the approval, question, plan and form cards share one set of text sizes, spacing and corners, and a form's labels, hints and "Required" are no longer small print.
## Antigravity
- A turn that Antigravity's plan limit stopped ends on a limit card with the reset time, as a Claude Code limit does, instead of showing the CLI's notice as the answer. - A turn that ended on the CLI's error notice ends as failed with its words, and a `run_agent` subagent that a limit or an error stopped ends as failed and says why. - Importing finds an Antigravity conversation in each folder it lists, and a conversation Yardlet started is listed only under the folder Yardlet opened it in.
## Fixes
- Keep tasks working with the lid closed turns on instead of saying Yardlet's helper is not available, and General › App shows Launch at login on a Mac where it was never turned on. - A Mac without a built-in lid (Mac mini, Mac Studio, iMac) no longer offers the lid setting.
